annotations.summary: LBAdminPortUnresponsive: admin/stats endpoint not answering probes

report.root_cause: lb admin listener is unavailable while the data listener remains healthy, consistent with a tolerated bind/listen setup failure; no triggering config change or specific socket error is established (ev_216, ev_218, ev_223, ev_224).

ruled_out.hypothesis: Host resource contention or exhaustion is preventing the admin port from responding.
A broad lb data-path outage or stalled data listener is causing the admin probe failure.
A newly deployed lb code defect is established as the cause.

ranked.root_cause: lb admin listener setup/configuration failure is tolerated independently of the data listener, leaving admin port unavailable; exact trigger/error is unknown.
lb-specific configuration change caused an invalid admin bind port or socket setup failure; timing and values are not verified.

params.value: validate current value and ensure listen_port+1 is valid and available; obtain approval before changing

findings.question: At and around 1790460080, did lb admin-port probe failures coincide with data-port failures or host CPU/memory pressure?
findings.summary: At 1790460080 the sampled lb admin port was down and admin probes remained at about 4 seconds throughout the observed interval, while all three lb data-backend probes were up at the samples around that timestamp. The sampled host CPU and memory series do not establish pressure coinciding with the probe failure: CPU was generally low but had a transient spike earlier, and memory stayed around 10–13%; no baseline comparison for these series or p99 result was obtained. Thus there is no observed coincident data-port failure or clear host pressure, but precise onset and ratio for the lb admin-port failure cannot be determined from the available samples.

findings.summary: Inconclusive: stopped (error) before a finding was submitted.

findings.question: Inspect the balancer code paths for admin listener binding/serving on data port +1; is there a specific defect consistent with a dead admin port while data ports stay healthy?
findings.summary: Yes. The stats/admin listener runs in its own thread after the data listener is established, and bind/listen failures only log a warning and return, leaving the data listener healthy—directly consistent with a dead admin port. I found no evidence in these paths of a defect that would unexpectedly kill an already-serving admin listener; port collision/invalid adjacent port or socket setup failure is explicitly tolerated this way. Recommend make startup report/propagate admin bind failure (or expose readiness) and validate the data port range so port+1 is valid. Tests could not run because Go is unavailable and this is a C++ project; no test result is available.
